pass_semantics.PASS: observed behaviour matches the pre-registered expectation, evidenced by a named artifact (log/capture/audit extract), with the full version record present
pass_semantics.FAIL: any deviation; automatic run FAIL for (i) any command reaching an adapter/device, (ii) any silent wrong value, (iii) any check closed without a result or a reasoned not-applicable
pass_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: written reason tied to the environment; never 'covered by unit tests'
pass_semantics.BLOCKED: a recorded prerequisite is missing; a blocked check is unexecuted, never passed
